requestDialog.title: Request signatures
requestDialog.sequentialHint: Signers must sign one after another in the defined order.
requestDialog.messagePlaceholder: Optional message, e.g. context or instructions …

signArea.title: Your signature is requested
signArea.legalNotice: By clicking "Sign" you provide a simple electronic signature as defined in Art. 3 no. 10 eIDAS; its legal effect follows Art. 25(1) eIDAS. This is not a qualified signature (QES). Timestamp, IP address, user agent and a cryptographic hash of the file are captured, included in the signature hash chain and written to the chained audit trail. Where an external time-stamping authority is reachable, the time is additionally attested under RFC 3161; otherwise it comes from the server clock — the certificate states which.

signConfirm.title: Sign document electronically?
signConfirm.body: You are signing the signature request "{title}". This action cannot be undone.

declineDialog.title: Decline signature
declineDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Why are you declining the signature? (required)

verify.valid: Signature valid — chain complete, file re-hashed and unchanged
verify.fileUnchanged: File unchanged (bytes re-hashed from object storage)
verify.fileChanged: File was modified after the request
verify.fileUnverifiable: File not verifiable — the stored object could not be read
verify.chainIncomplete: Chain incomplete — links are missing from the end of the ceremony
verify.timestampMissing: No external timestamp — the time comes from the server clock
verify.ipSelfReported: IP address is a client self-declaration
verify.creatorIsSigner: Requester and signer are the same person
